title: The train-access registry separates eighteen complete and twelve unfinished historical station rows
summary: Appendix B identifies 30 train-access cohort rows: 18 historical construction completions, two In Progress construction rows, and ten Pending construction rows, each preserved with design and projected construction fields. Denominator: All 30 named train-access cohort memberships in Appendix B, including the 12 rows not reported Complete in the historical snapshot.
